Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Classic Paisley Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Grey
Colors: Gray
Cover: 100% polyester, Stuffing: 100% polyester Made in the United States of imported materials 17"L x 17"W The beautiful paisley pattern featured on the front and back of this pillow can bring a touch of sophistication to your space. Spot clean. Put in dryer on low heat for 20 minutes to release wrinkles, or use garment steamer. Do not iron.
